boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain California State University-Bakersfield
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe Bakersfield food stops with late availability documented on current official location pages. Hours can change on holidays, so recheck before leaving.

cards.title: A Round-the-Clock Diner Stop
cards.subtitle: Sit-down food south of CSUB on Gosford Road
cards.notes: Use this for a flexible sit-down meal after other kitchens close; confirm holiday service on the official location page before departing.
cards.short_summary: An all-hours diner with walk-in seating and takeout.
cards.evidence_claim: Denny's official page identifies the restaurant at 4440 Gosford Road and lists it as open 24 hours every day, with walk-ins and takeout available.
cards.access_notes: The official location page lists 24-hour restaurant service Monday through Sunday; contact the restaurant to confirm holiday hours.

cards.title: Stockdale Burgers After Midnight
cards.subtitle: Dine-in and drive-through service east of campus
cards.notes: Head east on Stockdale Highway for a late burger stop; check the official page's daily-hours panel before choosing dine-in or drive-through.
cards.short_summary: A Stockdale Highway burger counter serving past midnight nightly.
cards.evidence_claim: In-N-Out's official location page lists dine-in and drive-through seating at 5100 Stockdale Highway, with normal closing times of 1 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 1:30 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: In-N-Out Burger - Bakersfield, CA, 5100 Stockdale Hwy.
cards.access_notes: Normal hours are 10:30 a.m.–1 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 10:30 a.m.–1:30 a.m. Friday–Saturday; verify today's hours before leaving.

cards.title: Chicken Fingers on Stockdale
cards.subtitle: A close-to-campus counter with weekend hours to 2 a.m.
cards.notes: Choose this nearby Stockdale stop when the group wants a short menu; Friday and Saturday provide the latest verified service window.
cards.short_summary: A nearby chicken-finger counter open until midnight or later.
cards.evidence_claim: Raising Cane's official page places this restaurant at 11403 Stockdale Highway and lists dine-in and drive-through hours until midnight Sunday–Thursday and 2 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: Raising Cane's in Bakersfield, CA - 11403 Stockdale Highway
cards.access_notes: Dine-in and drive-through close at midnight Sunday–Thursday and 2 a.m. Friday–Saturday, according to the official location page.

cards.title: A Next-Door Stockdale Taco Run
cards.subtitle: Tacos and burritos beside the Stockdale late-night cluster
cards.notes: Pair this with the Stockdale corridor when schedules run late; note that Friday and Saturday extend two hours beyond weeknight closing.
cards.short_summary: A nearby taco counter with its longest hours on Friday and Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: Del Taco's official location page identifies 11409 Stockdale Highway and lists store hours until midnight Sunday–Thursday and 2 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: Order from Del Taco in Bakersfield, California
cards.access_notes: Store service ends at midnight Sunday–Thursday and 2 a.m. Friday–Saturday; the official page lists the same windows for delivery.

cards.title: The Farther-West Drive-Through
cards.subtitle: Late drive-through hours along Stockdale Highway
cards.notes: Save this westbound option for nights when a drive-through matters; dine-in closes earlier, so plan around the service channel shown online.
cards.short_summary: A Stockdale drive-through operating later than its dining room.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell's official page lists the 16132 Stockdale Highway drive-through until 1 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 3 a.m. Friday–Saturday and labels the location Open Late.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell in Bakersfield, CA - 16132 Stockdale Hwy
cards.access_notes: Drive-through hours are 7 a.m.–1 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 7 a.m.–3 a.m. Friday–Saturday; posted dine-in hours end earlier.

cards.title: A Gosford Drive-Through Until 1
cards.subtitle: Burgers, chili, salads, and baked potatoes south of campus
cards.notes: Use the Gosford location for a menu spanning sandwiches and lighter sides; both its restaurant and drive-through share the late closing time.
cards.short_summary: A south-of-campus fast-food stop open until 1 a.m. daily.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy's official page lists the restaurant at 4650 Gosford Road and shows both restaurant and drive-through hours from 6:30 a.m. to 1 a.m. every day.
cards.source_title: Wendy's 4650 Gosford Road in Bakersfield, CA
cards.access_notes: The official page lists restaurant and drive-through service until 1 a.m. Monday through Sunday.

cards.title: Gosford Burgers Past Midnight
cards.subtitle: A late drive-through with weekend hours to 2 a.m.
cards.notes: Continue south on Gosford for a post-midnight burger run; Friday and Saturday have the latest closing time on the published schedule.
cards.short_summary: A Gosford fast-food counter serving until 1 or 2 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Carl's Jr.'s official page identifies 5555 Gosford Road and lists closing at 1 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 2 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Posted hours end at 1 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 2 a.m. Friday–Saturday; verify current service before travel.

cards.entity_name: Jack in the Box — 3350 Stine Avenue
cards.title: An All-Night Stine Drive-Through
cards.subtitle: Drive-through access continues after the lobby closes
cards.notes: Use the drive-through after 10 p.m.; the official page shows the lobby closing then while vehicle service continues around the clock.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour drive-through with a lobby that closes earlier.
cards.evidence_claim: Jack in the Box's official page identifies 3350 Stine Avenue and displays 24-hour drive-through service every day, while lobby hours end at 10 p.m.
cards.source_title: Order from Jack In The Box in Bakersfield, California
cards.access_notes: Drive-through service is listed as 24 hours daily; the lobby is listed from 6 a.m. to 10 p.m. daily.

cards.title: Coffee Road's 2 A.M. Counter
cards.subtitle: Dine-in remains available into the early morning
cards.notes: Pick this northwest option when indoor seating matters late; its official schedule keeps dine-in open as late as the drive-through.
cards.short_summary: A late-night chicken counter with indoor seating into the early morning.
cards.evidence_claim: Raising Cane's official page identifies the 3224 Coffee Road restaurant and lists dine-in and drive-through service until 2 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 2:30 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: Raising Cane's in Bakersfield, CA - 3224 Coffee Road
cards.access_notes: Dine-in and drive-through close at 2 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 2:30 a.m. Friday–Saturday, according to the official page.

cards.title: A Weekend Midnight Pancake Stop
cards.subtitle: A farther-west sit-down option for Friday and Saturday
cards.notes: Reserve this longer westbound run for weekend sit-down plans; the restaurant closes earlier on Sunday through Thursday.
cards.short_summary: A sit-down pancake restaurant reaching midnight on weekends.
cards.evidence_claim: IHOP's official location page identifies the restaurant at 29541 Stockdale Highway and lists hours until midnight on Friday and Saturday and 10 p.m. Sunday–Thursday.
cards.source_title: Pancake Restaurant in Bakersfield on 29541 Stockdale Hwy | IHOP
cards.access_notes: Open until midnight Friday and Saturday; Sunday–Thursday service ends at 10 p.m. This is a farther-west destination from campus.
